in_latin.meaning: nomen femininum, significatio: scorpion, parvus, humanus
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen femininum, significatio: scorpion, parvus, humanus. Verbum Pennie derivatum est a nomine Anglo-Saxonicum Pennie, significans: scorpion, parvus, humanus.
